Crisp crumbed ham croquettes with a creamy centre, a Little Havana bakery classic. Melt 60g butter, cook 80g flour for 1 minute and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Stir in 200g finely chopped ham and nutmeg, chill 3 hours. Shape 20 logs, roll in egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C until golden.
the studio meetings Chili talks his way into

Chili's Miami, before he heads out to LA
Puff pastry squares filled with guava paste and cream cheese, brushed with egg, baked at 200C for 18 minutes and dusted with sugar while hot.
M: he knows exactly how a scene should go
Sirloin seared hard and rested, sliced. Pan sauce: shallot sweated in the fat, red wine reduced, cold butter whisked in. Double-fried frites.
Rows of chopped chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese on cos with red wine vinaigrette.
W: the schlock horror producer who needs one good script

Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge, a handful of caramel popcorn (popcorn tossed in brown sugar and butter caramel, baked to set) and salted peanuts. Pop 40g popcorn kernels. Melt 50g butter with 80g brown sugar, toss through the popcorn and bake at 150C for 10 minutes to set. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop 8 balls of vanilla ice cream into four bowls, pour over the fudge and top with the popcorn and 50g salted peanuts.
K: Chili's whole acting lesson in two words

45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper, rolled between tins, celery stick. For each drink, put 45ml vodka, 120ml tomato juice, 10ml lemon juice, 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce, 2 dashes hot sauce and a pinch each of celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice. Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times, strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Makes four.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the bechamel up to 1 day ahead; fry to serve

steps.text: Melt the butter, cook the flour for 1 minute and whisk in the milk until very thick.
Stir in the ham and nutmeg, spread on a tray and chill for 3 hours.
Shape into 20 logs and roll in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden.

dishes.make_ahead: Assemble up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; bake to serve

steps.text: Cut each pastry sheet into 9 squares.
Put a slice of guava paste and a teaspoon of cream cheese on half the squares.
Top with the other squares, press the edges with a fork and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden, then dust with sugar while hot.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the sauce while the steak rests; fry the chips twice

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites and fry at 140C for 5 minutes, then rest.
Season the steaks and sear hard for 3 minutes a side, then rest.
Sweat the shallots in the pan fat, add the wine and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in the butter.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp.
Slice the steak and spoon the sauce over.

dishes.make_ahead: Caramel popcorn up to 2 days airtight

steps.text: Pop the popcorn kernels.
Melt the butter with the brown sugar, toss through the popcorn and bake at 150C for 10 minutes to set.
Melt the chocolate with the cream for hot fudge.
Scoop ice cream into four bowls, pour over the fudge and top with popcorn and peanuts.

ingredients.item: celery salt and pepper, to taste

steps.text: Put a share of vodka, tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice.
Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times.

m.note: he knows exactly how a scene should go
m.how: Fry 1kg potatoes cut into thin frites at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 185C until crisp. Season 4 sirloin steaks, about 800g, sear hard for 3 minutes a side and rest. Sweat 2 chopped shallots in the pan fat, add 150ml red wine and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in 50g cold butter. Slice the steak and spoon the sauce over.
